thought: Start with the alert: what is failing and how badly?
Pull error rate, latency, pool, disk and db numbers for the last 30s to see which subsystem looks off.

5xx on /checkout fits many causes, so I'm listing candidates with the test that separates them. The cache-miss, deprecated /v1/cart and slow /reports lines appear in every window and don't line up with the 5xx errors, so I'm ignoring them.

hypotheses.cause: A recent configuration change broke the database connection
DB connection pool exhausted by leaked connections
Disk is full so writes fail
Database server is hung or unresponsive

thought: Read the actual error lines to see what the failing requests complain about.
Disconfirming test: if the disk is full, writes fail with ENOSPC. The ERROR lines don't mention it, but verify directly.
The errors name a database host. Test the db connection itself.
The db refuses connections rather than timing out. Check whether the config changed recently.

The log says 'connection refused db-prod-02:5432 while opening checkout transaction' and the config diff shows db_host changed from db-prod-01 to db-prod-02 in v4 by deploy-bot. Pool usage in the metrics is far below db_pool_max with no QueuePool errors, and the disk write test passed. The cache-miss, deprecated /v1/cart and slow /reports lines appear in every window and don't line up with the 5xx errors, so I'm ignoring them.

hypotheses.cause: A recent configuration change broke the database connection
evidence_for: connection refused db-prod-02:5432 while opening checkout transaction

hypotheses.cause: DB connection pool exhausted by leaked connections
evidence_against: no QueuePool limit errors in the log

error lines name db-prod-02, not payment-gw

evidence_against: host db-prod-02 refuses quickly (not a hang); the previous host was fine

thought: Rolling back to v3 undoes the single change that matches the evidence. It is medium risk and reversible, and the dry run can confirm v3 exists.

action.expected_effect: db_host returns to db-prod-01, checkout 5xx stop and error_rate drops below 2%
action.rollback_plan: Re-apply config v4 (db_host=db-prod-02) from config history if the rollback makes things worse

action.summary: Config v4 pointed db_host at db-prod-02, which refuses connections. Rolled back to v3 and checkout recovered.
